data.name: Joydip
data.gender_notes: Joydip is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Delight or Joy in the dip of the river
data.long_meaning: The name 'Joydip' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'joya' meaning delight or joy and 'dip' meaning dip or immerse. This name is believed to signify the joy one feels when immersed in the river or in the company of loved ones. The name Joydip carries the meaning “Delight or Joy in the dip of the river” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Joydip usually hope their child will grow to embody delight or joy in the dip of the river and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the joy and delight one experiences in life and in spirituality.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joydip total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
